definitions.explanation: One part out of ten. Japan uses the 割 system where one 割 equals 10%, alongside the percentage system.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一割|いちわり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧だ。
examples.english: One tenth of the sales is profit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧のうち{一割|いちわり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{外国人|がいこくじん}→外国人：02869_gaikokujin⟧だった。
examples.english: About 10% of the participants were foreigners.

examples.japanese: ⟦{定価|ていか}→定価：04066_teika⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{一割|いちわり}⟦{引|び}き→〜引き：28470_biki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦クーポン→クーポン：06446_kuupon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I used a coupon that let me buy it at a 10% discount from the regular price.

notes:
The ⟦{割|わり}→割：03194_wari⟧ system is Japan's traditional way of expressing fractions and percentages. {一割|いちわり} = 10%, {二割|にわり} = 20%, etc. Below {一割|いちわり}, the scale continues with {分|ぶ} (1%) and {厘|りん} (0.1%).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一割|いちわり}⟦{引|び}き→〜引き：28470_biki⟧ — 10% discount
- {一割|いちわり}{増|ぞう} — 10% increase
- {一割|いちわり}⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧ — 10% co-payment (especially in healthcare)
- ⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧{一割|いちわり} — about 10%

THE {割|わり} SYSTEM:
- {一割|いちわり} = 10%
- {三割|さんわり} = 30%
- {五割|ごわり} = 50% (half)
- {三割五分|さんわりごぶ} = 35% (used especially in baseball batting averages)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 10⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧ — 10 percent (Western-style; also common)
- ⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ — one tenth (fraction form)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The ⟦{割|わり}→割：03194_wari⟧ system is used commonly in daily life for discounts ({二割引|にわりびき} = 20% off), medical co-payments ({三割負担|さんわりふたん} = 30% co-pay), and baseball statistics (⟦{打率|だりつ}→打率：07113_daritsu⟧{三割|さんわり} = .300 batting average).
